Have you heard these exciting AI news? - April 10, 2026 AI Updates Weekly
Presented by Lev Selector

Slides on GDrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dmj00iilSP-JYmriMUUaHCKz5X54e3UX?ths=true

Slides on GitHub - https://github.com/lselector/seminar
    (click on pptx file, then on "raw" or download button on the right)

-------------------------------------------------------
Question to you: 
Which "Claw" or other desktop "Digital Employee" you recommend?

-------------------------------------------------------
Need AI Consulting ?
 - Enterprise AI Solutions - https://EAIS.ai
 - Linkedin - https://www.linkedin.com/in/levselector
 - GitHub - https://github.com/lselector

-------------------------------------------------------
Our books:

"Artificial Intelligence In Business: Strategies That Work"
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FKZ3364G/

"AI Product Manager: Building Tomorrow"
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FMS9NFK9/

"How to Learn with AI?: A Practical Guide for Students, Professionals, and Self-Learners"
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FWLNVQMJ/

"Professional + AI: Future-Proofing Your Career"
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GBXLCTZQ

"FP&A + AI: How to Work Faster, Smarter, and Deliver More Value"
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FY6Z5BBW

--------- Contents of today's video:

00:00 Intro
00:08 "Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change"
00:32 "Intelligence is the ability to avoid doing work yet getting the work done"
00:54 Crowd-sourced "LM Arena" Leaderboard
02:06 MemPalace Memory System
03:45 Anthropic Managed Agents
04:29 Agentic AI Solutions
08:32 Claude Buddy - virtual pet built into Claude Code
09:07 Anthropic Restricts Third-Party Claude Usage
09:22 OpenClaw Updates
09:39 Claude Code Updates
10:06 Matt Berman challenged Hacker
10:24 Journey, a registry for AI agent workflow kits
11:27 Google Gemma 4 family of open-source models
12:01 OpenAgents - Multi-Agent Platform
12:25 Abacus CoWork
13:04 Meta Muse Spark
14:12 Perplexity Computer Tax Prep
14:36 Anthropic acquired Coefficient Bio
14:50 Deep Learning NYU Course 2020
15:25 Edgeclaw open-source privacy for AI agents
15:46 OpenClaw + Ollama + Qwen 3.5
16:01 The Anthropic vs. Pentagon dispute
16:33 Claude Code with the Qwen 3.6 Plus model
16:55 TRIZ & AI
18:36 HERE.NOW
19:06 HeyGen Avatar V
19:31 Ole Lehmann Used Council Approach
20:29 Hermes Agent - open-source, self-improving
21:09 Karpathy's wiki + Hermes Agent
21:39 Karpathy's Obsidian RAG + Claude Code
22:01 Graphify - Claude Code + Obsidian wiki
22:38 Obsidian plus Claude
23:03 Microsoft MAI Models
23:20 Cursor 3.0 - a major update
23:39 Alibaba Wan 2.1 AI video model - open-source
23:53 Claude's Microsoft 365 connector
24:20 Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview
25:04 Caveman plugin/skill for Claude Code
27:26 Jobs & Layoffs

----

Takeaways:

1. AI agents are rapidly replacing traditional software workflows. Desktop agents like OpenClaw, Hermes, and Abacus CoWork are making it possible to automate computer tasks, turning users from coders into managers of AI agents.

2. Lightweight memory systems like MemPalace and Karpathy's Obsidian RAG show that personal and small business AI setups do not need heavy enterprise infrastructure. Simple tools like ChromaDB, SQLite, and markdown wikis are sufficient.

3. The competitive landscape is intensifying across all fronts. Meta released Muse Spark, Google open-sourced Gemma 4, Alibaba released Wan 2.1, and Anthropic is holding back their powerful Mythos model due to safety concerns.

----

Quotes:

"Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change." - Stephen Hawking

"Intelligence is the ability to avoid doing work yet getting the work done." - Linus Torvalds

"Periods of social instability are historically the best times for individual growth."

----

Summary:

In this talk Lev Selector covers the AI landscape for the week of April 10, 2026. 

The discussion spans the LM Arena leaderboard where Claude leads, the MemPalace hierarchical memory system for agents, Anthropic's new managed agents service, and a broad survey of the agentic AI explosion including OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor 3.0, and many others. 

Notable news includes Meta's Muse Spark model, Google's open-source Gemma 4, Anthropic's unreleased Mythos model held back for safety, the Anthropic vs Pentagon dispute resolution, and practical tools like the Caveman token-reduction plugin, HeyGen avatars, and Karpathy-inspired Obsidian RAG workflows for personal knowledge management.

----

Keywords:
AI agents, Claude, OpenClaw, Hermes, LM Arena, MemPalace, Anthropic, managed agents, Gemma 4, Meta Muse Spark, Cursor 3.0, TRIZ, Obsidian RAG, Karpathy, HeyGen, Caveman plugin, Mythos, Perplexity, Abacus CoWork, OpenAgents
